description: The Polymarket adapter of the Eclipse Markets suite (Wing B), in M0 data form. Gamma-shaped fixtures normalize into Eclipse Book canonical Instruments with resolution criteria stored verbatim and hash-pinned (a criteria edit re-sync produces a named CRITERIA_CHANGED event; positions keep criteria as of entry), CLOB-shaped books normalize into canonical Books and fee-truth Quotes (all-in cost from the venue's dated fee schedule; stale schedule degrades to FEE_UNVERIFIED), and UMA-shaped resolutions enter the core lifecycle where DISPUTED is a first-class state. Every output carries money_class REAL. The US trading surface is absent by design — no order, trade, account, or API-key tool exists, and geoblock-circumvention-shaped tool names are refused by name. The forecast is the venue's priced output, never Cyan Eclipse's prediction, and no output carries a probability field.
